description: Her bra size from her underbust and bust measurements (inches or cm, decimals allowed): her base US size, sister sizes one band each way, the UK size, EU and French sizes where their tables give the whole size, and the usual letter size (S/M/L). Use this when a shopper gives her measurements and wants her size in general. The answer includes a confidence badge and a reason: pass both on with the size. If the measurements are refused, tell her the reason given.

bust.description: Around the fullest part of the bust, the tape flat and not pressing in. Decimals allowed.

underbust.description: Snug around the ribcage, just under the bust, after breathing out. Decimals allowed.

unit.description: The unit both measurements are in: inches (in) or centimetres (cm).

name: bra_size_from_measurements
title: Bra size from measurements
